title: Evaluation of a Clause with a First Literal
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $l$ be a positive or negated literal on one of $n$ Boolean variables, let $c$ be a finite list of such literals, and let $x$ assign a Boolean value to each variable. The clause formed by placing $l$ before $c$ evaluates to the Boolean disjunction of the value of $l$ and the evaluation of $c$ on $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $l$ is a literal on one of the $n$ variables
$c$ is a clause, hence a finite list of literals on those variables
$x$ assigns a Boolean value to each of the $n$ variables
